reference: Installed native MSBuild; version recorded by the differential harness

limitations: Ordinal and invariant comparisons; process-locale overloads rejected
Split overloads with a truncating count rejected
Only registered static members
No reflection, host files, registry or process environment
Explicit clock and GUID providers
Regex excludes backreferences, special groups and quantified groups
DateTime formatting limited to ISO and yyyy-MM-dd
Integer conversions limited to safe numeric precision
Virtual-root path semantics
StableStringHash Legacy and 32-bit FNV modes
Explicit portable feature wave
File timestamps are not synthesized
Bundled .NET SDK default property/item model
Web, Worker, Razor and MSTest identity/default markers; their build toolchains are not executed
Requested SDK versions recorded; installed SDK resolution is native-only
Execution and metadata linking are supplied by the compilation host
Strings, numeric primitives, Boolean, Char, byte payloads and virtual file references
Serialized objects, BinaryFormatter, arbitrary resource types and custom encodings require native tools
Dependent-source naming recognizes ordinary namespace/type declarations
Project and Executable profiles; host execution remains permission-controlled
Registered virtual tasks only
No native Csc, Exec, custom task assemblies or host file writes
Inputs/Outputs are retained; native timestamp-based incremental target skipping is not emulated
Task outputs and generated files are committed to virtual state only on success

native-task-execution.reason: Exec and native compiler tasks execute only in a trusted native host.

external-task-assembly.reason: Loading arbitrary MSBuild task assemblies requires native MSBuild.

unregistered-sdk.reason: SDKs outside the registered portable SDK models require native resolution.

binary-reference-linking.reason: Binary references are retained for inspection; source compilation cannot link arbitrary CLR assemblies.

nuget-restore-linking.reason: NuGet restore and linking package assemblies require native tools.

analyzer-execution.reason: Roslyn analyzer assemblies are not executed in the portable evaluator.

serialized-resources.reason: Serialized/custom resource objects require the native resource toolchain.

host-property-functions.reason: Property functions cannot access host files, registry, processes or arbitrary reflection.

foreign-language-compilation.reason: Foreign project records are inspectable but a portable compilation request is blocked.
